title: Figure 6. Bilayer graphene tunneling device structure (layered gate stack)
description: Color 3D schematic of a stacked device with yellow gate layers and blue SiO2 layers enclosing two graphene sheets, labeled "Top Gate VTG," "10 nm SiO2," "1 nm SiO2," "600 nm," "VTL," "VTR," "VBL," "VBR," and "Bottom Gate VBG." Captioned "Figure 6. Bilayer graphene tunneling device structure. Two sheets of graphene are separated by a one-nanometer thick insulating of graphene." Text below discusses manipulation of spin qubits in graphene quantum dots relative to GaAs.
